achievements.name: Frugal Engineer
achievements.description: Complete any scenario using less than 75% of the allocated budget limit.

achievements.name: Zero Waste Data
achievements.description: Downlink over 98% of all scientific data collected by your instruments.

achievements.name: Perfect Margin
achievements.description: Achieve over 15% positive margin on mass, power, and delta-V simultaneously.

achievements.name: Mission Survivor
achievements.description: Successfully complete a mission with less than 20% hull remaining.

achievements.name: Master Communicator
achievements.description: Maintain uninterrupted high-bandwidth link across interplanetary distances.

achievements.name: Scientific Pioneer
achievements.description: Gather more than 1,000 science points in a single mission run.

achievements.name: Survived Three Failures
achievements.description: Encounter and successfully resolve three distinct critical in-flight emergencies.

disclaimer: GTA NASA uses a simplified educational engineering model for pedagogical gameplay. It does not replace professional mission certification or NASA flight dynamics software.
